verses.pali: “Kammalakkhaṇo, bhikkhave, bālo, kammalakkhaṇo paṇḍito, apadānasobhanī paññāti.
verses.english: “A fool is characterized by their deeds, and an astute person is characterized by their deeds, for wisdom shines in its traces.

verses.pali: Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bālo veditabbo.
verses.english: A fool is known by three things.
Bad conduct by way of body, speech, and mind.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bālo veditabbo.
verses.english: These are the three things by which a fool is known.

verses.pali: Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito veditabbo.
verses.english: An astute person is known by three things.
Good conduct by way of body, speech, and mind.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito veditabbo.
verses.english: These are the three things by which an astute person is known.
So you should train like this:

verses.pali: ‘yehi tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bālo veditabbo te tayo dhamme abhinivajjetvā, yehi tīhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito veditabbo te tayo dhamme samādāya vattissāmā’ti.
verses.english: ‘We will shun the three things by which a fool is known, and we will undertake and follow the three things by which an astute person is known.’
